settings.fpsHint: Higher values are limited by your display's refresh rate.
settings.frameTimeGraphHint: Shows simulation and draw time per frame in the top-left corner. Measures script work only, not GPU time.
settings.frameTimeGraphModeHint: Separate plots simulation and draw time as their own curve; combined plots one curve for the whole frame.
settings.frameGraphScaleHint: Top of the vertical axis. Dynamic keeps the curves large but rescales as the load changes; a fixed value keeps every moment of a round directly comparable.
